symbols.name: OpenApiSchemaRef
symbols.summary: Represents an OpenAPI schema that serializes exclusively as a JSON Reference to a component schema in the document (i.e., "$ref": "#/components/schemas/{name}").
symbols.remarks: This helper is useful in ASP.NET Core (.NET 10) with OpenAPI 3.1 where the older OpenApiReference model is no longer used for schemas. Instead of constructing a reference object, you can return an instance of this class wherever an Microsoft.OpenApi.OpenApiSchema is expected to cause the serializer to emit a $ref. Example usage in a schema transformer: schema.Properties["nodes"] = new OpenApiSchema { Type = JsonSchemaType.Array | JsonSchemaType.Null, Items = new OpenApiSchemaRef("SpecificationNode"), Description = "List of specification nodes" };
